blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Despite recent advancements in 3D generation, models often struggle to produce assets with high visual fidelity.
To bridge this gap, we propose OREO, an alignment framework that enhances the realism of 3D generators by leveraging rich 2D diffusion priors.
Instead of relying on static datasets, OREO establishes a dynamic optimization loop that produces on-the-fly edited renderings as 2D pseudo-targets.
At its core, we introduce Reinforced Editing, which utilizes a 2D model to refine rendered views of the 3D output, enhancing their overall visual fidelity while preserving the underlying geometry, viewpoint, and content.
These refined views serve as high-quality supervision targets, enabling the 3D generator to learn from its own generated samples and progressively improve its visual quality.
Experiments demonstrate that OREO effectively improves upon pre-trained baselines, producing 3D assets with enhanced visual realism.
Our project page is at https://theericma.github.io/oreo/ .
blocks.zh:
尽管最近在3D生成方面有所进步,但模型往往难以产生视觉高度忠诚的资产。
为了弥补这一差距,我们建议OREO,一个通过利用丰富的2D扩散前身,增强3D生成器现实性的对齐框架.
OREO没有依赖静态数据集,而是建立了动态优化循环,以2D伪目标生成在飞行中编辑的渲染.
作为核心,我们引入了强化编辑,它利用2D模型来完善对3D输出的渲染观点,增强它们的整体视觉忠诚度,同时保留基本的几何、观点和内容。
这些精细的观点成为高质量的监督目标,使3D生成器能够学习自己生成的样本,并逐步提高其视觉质量.
实验表明,OREO在经过预先训练的基线上有效改进,产生具有增强视觉现实性的3D资产.

blocks.en:
Recent 3D generators, such as Trellis [ 38 ] and the Hunyuan3D series [ 43 , 51 , 13 , 16 ] , have greatly simplified the 3D content creation process.
However, despite their strong performance in geometry generation, achieving high visual fidelity remains challenging.
Generated assets often lack intricate textures and fine-grained details observed in real-world subjects.
This gap becomes more pronounced for imaginative and out-of-distribution references, where existing 3D priors provide limited appearance coverage.
This limitation largely stems from the limited scale and appearance diversity of high-quality 3D data compared with billion-scale 2D imagery.
Consequently, 3D generative models may not fully capture the visual detail needed for photorealism.
blocks.zh:
近期的3D发电机,如Trellis [38]和Hunyuan3D系列[43,51,13,16],大大简化了3D内容创建过程.
然而,尽管它们在几何学一代中表现强劲,但实现高视力的忠诚仍然是挑战。
产生的资产往往缺乏复杂的纹理和在现实世界中观察到的精细细节。
这种差距对于富有想象力和分配外的参考来说更加明显,因为现有的3D前身的外观覆盖面有限。
这一局限性主要源于与十亿级二维图像相比,高质量三维数据的规模和外观多样性有限.
因此,3D基因模型可能无法充分捕捉光现实主义所需的视觉细节.

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we propose to distill the rich visual priors of pre-trained 2D diffusion models into 3D generators.
These models encapsulate a deep understanding of visual fidelity and fine-grained details, far surpassing the scope of existing 3D datasets.
To this end, we introduce the On-the-fly Rendering Editing Optimization (OREO) framework, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
The core idea is to establish a dynamic alignment mechanism: instead of relying solely on static 3D training data, the generator improves through supervision generated on the fly.
Specifically, OREO implements a Render-Edit-Optimize loop, where the model renders views from its current output, receives corrective edits to enhance realism, and uses these refined views as supervision targets.
blocks.zh:
为了弥合这一差距,我们提议将预先训练的2D扩散模型丰富的视觉前科提炼成3D发电机.
这些模型囊括了对视觉忠诚和精细细节的深刻理解,远远超过了现有的3D数据集的范围.
为此,我们介绍了图1所示的《在线渲染优化编辑框架》。
核心思想是建立动态对齐机制:不只依靠静态的3D训练数据,发电机通过在苍蝇上产生的监督改进.
具体来说,OREO执行一个Render-Edit-Optimize循环,其中模型从其当前输出中得出观点,接受修正编辑以加强现实主义,并将这些精细的视图作为监督目标.

blocks.en:
At the core of this loop is the Reinforced Editing algorithm, which generates edited views as supervision signals.
To ensure reliable guidance, Reinforced Editing prioritizes structure preservation, focusing on improving visual fidelity while maintaining the original spatial layout.
Inspired by recent inversion-free editing techniques, this approach mitigates the unwanted geometric deviations common in standard editing methods, helping the edited renderings better preserve the viewpoint and structure of the rendered source.
To turn these refined targets into effective supervision, we propose Contrastive Distillation, which treats the edited view as a positive and the original rendering as a negative, and distills the fidelity gap into the 3D generator through a latent-space contrastive objective.
Experiments on Trellis show that OREO produces 3D assets with improved visual fidelity.
In summary, our contributions are as follows: 1. We introduce OREO, a novel alignment framework that leverages pre-trained 2D diffusion priors to enhance the fidelity of 3D generators through an on-the-fly optimization loop with dynamic 2D pseudo-targets. 2. At its core, we propose Reinforced Editing, an image editing algorithm that improves the visual fidelity of rendered views while preserving structure, coupled with Contrastive Distillation that distills the visual changes between edited and original renderings into the 3D generator for post-training. 3. We validate the effectiveness of OREO on Trellis, a state-of-the-art 3D generator. Results show that OREO effectively improves visual fidelity and appearance details over the pre-trained baseline.
blocks.zh:
这个循环的核心是强化编辑算法,它作为监督信号生成编辑过的视图.
为确保可靠的指导,"强化编辑"优先安排结构保存,注重在保持原空间布局的同时,提高视觉忠贞度.
受近期无反演编辑技术的启发,这种方法缓解了标准编辑方法中常见的不想要的几何偏差,帮助编辑的渲染更好地保存了渲染源的观点和结构.
为了将这些精细的目标转化为有效的监督,我们提出对比性扭曲(Contrastive Distruction),它把编辑后的观点视为正向的,而原始渲染则视为负向的,并且通过潜在-空间对比性的目标将忠诚性差距提炼成3D生成器.
有关Trellis的实验显示,OREO在视觉忠贞性得到提高的情况下产生3D资产.
总之,我们的贡献如下: 1. 我们引入了OREO,这是一种新颖的对齐框架,它利用预先训练的2D扩散前科,通过动态2D伪目标的飞行上优化循环,增强3D发电机的忠诚度. 2. 作为核心,我们提议加强编辑,这是一种图像编辑算法,在保留结构的同时,提高所渲染观点的视觉可靠性,同时将编辑和原渲染之间的视觉变化提炼成3D生成器,供培训后使用。 3. 我们验证OREO在Trellis这一最新3D生成器上的有效性。 结果显示,OREO比预先训练的基线有效改善了视觉忠诚度和外观细节.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learning-based 3D Generation [ 26 , 42 ] and Generator Post-training. Recent learning-based 3D generation [ 38 , 51 , 44 , 19 , 8 , 17 , 5 , 23 , 18 , 49 , 40 , 41 , 20 , 35 , 24 , 9 , 25 ] synthesizes assets feed-forward in latent spaces, but reliance on synthetic data such as Objaverse [ 6 ] caps visual fidelity and texture detail.
Photo3D [ 21 ] performs offline detail enhancement on Trellis, but its edits do not explicitly preserve source-view structure.
OREO instead transfers 2D appearance priors online through structure-aligned edited renderings.
blocks.zh:
基于学习的三维生成[26,42]和发电机后培训。 最近基于学习的3D生成[38,51,44,19,8,17,5,23,18,49,40,41,20,35,24,9,25]在潜伏空间中合成了向信息传输的资产,但依赖于Objaverse[6]等合成数据,盖住了视觉的忠诚度和纹理细节.
Photo3D [21]在Trellis上进行离线细节增强,但其编辑并未明确保留源视图结构.
OREO转而通过结构对齐的编辑渲染将 2D 外观前缀在线传输.

blocks.en:
2D Image Editing for Fidelity-Enhancing Supervision. Effective supervision requires edits that enhance fidelity while preserving viewpoint and structure.
Training-based image editors [ 1 , 48 , 32 , 50 ] inject appearance details but do not constrain viewpoint or layout, while inversion-based methods [ 11 , 27 , 31 ] reconstruct an input before editing it.
Reinforced Editing builds on FlowEdit [ 15 ] , which couples source and target trajectories to edit images without inversion.
blocks.zh:
2D Fidelity-加强监管的图像编辑. 有效的监督需要编辑,以加强忠诚,同时保持观点和结构。
基于培训的图像编辑器[1,48,32,50]注入外观细节,但并不限制视角或布局,而基于反演的方法[11,27,31]在编辑前重建一个输入.
强化编辑基于FlowEdit[15],夫妇源头和目标轨迹可以编辑图像而不反演.

blocks.en:
2D Priors for 3D Editing and Generation. Although 2D priors have been explored for 3D editing and generation, existing methods do not directly meet the goal of post-training a feed-forward 3D generator.
On the one hand, methods such as Instruct-NeRF2NeRF [ 10 ] , DreamEditor [ 52 ] , GaussianEditor [ 34 ] , DFFSplat [ 14 ] , Image Sculpting [ 45 ] , MvDrag3D [ 2 ] , and Omni-3DEdit [ 4 ] edit individual instances or scenes, rather than post-training a generalizable 3D generator.
GeoDiffusion [ 3 ] instead uses geometric conditions to control image generation for object detection data.
On the other hand, score-distillation methods such as DreamFusion [ 28 ] , Magic3D [ 22 ] , and ProlificDreamer [ 36 ] are optimization-based text-to-3D methods whose input setting and inference pipeline differ from those used by OREO for learning-based image-to-3D generator post-training, making them unsuitable for direct quantitative comparison with our framework.
DMD [ 46 ] is closer to a generator-learning paradigm and is therefore retained as a reasonable score-distillation ablation baseline; however, it still relies on implicit score-gradient supervision.
OREO uses high-fidelity, structure-aligned edited renderings as explicit 2D pseudo-targets to provide stable online supervision for 3D generator post-training.
blocks.zh:
3D编辑和生成的2D前传. 尽管为3D编辑和生成探索了2D前身,但现有方法并没有直接达到训练后向3D生成器的目标.
一方面,如Istruct-NERF2NERF [10],DreamEditor [52],高斯编辑 [34],DFFSplate [14],图像雕塑 [45],MvDrag3D [2],以及Omni-3Dedit [4] 编辑单个实例或场景,而不是训练后通用的3D生成器.
GeoDifmation [3] 转而使用几何条件来控制图像生成,用于对象检测数据.
另一方面,诸如DreamFusion [28],Magic3D [22],和ProlificDreamer [36] 等分数稀释方法都是基于优化的文本到3D方法,其输入设置和推论管道与OREO用于基于学习的图像到3D生成器后培训的方法不同,因此不适合与我们的框架直接进行定量比较.
DMD [46] 更接近于生成器-学习范式,因此被保留为合理的分数稀释基准;然而,它仍然依赖于隐含的分数级监督.
OREO使用高纯度,结构对齐的编辑渲染作为明确的2D伪目标,为3D生成器的训练后提供稳定的在线监督.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We present OREO, an alignment framework that enhances 3D visual fidelity via on-the-fly optimization.
An overview of the full pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 2 .
We leverage a pre-trained 2D editing model to construct edited renderings as 2D pseudo-targets on the fly, enabling generator post-training without paired 3D ground-truth supervision.
Each iteration rolls out the generator to obtain a 3D asset and renders it from a sampled camera pose.
Building on the flow-matching and inversion-free editing formulation in Sec. 3.2 , Reinforced Editing in Sec. 3.3 enhances the view while preserving structure.
Sec. 3.4 then distills this improvement into the 3D generator.

A critical step in our pipeline is transforming the rendered view x src x^{\texttt{src}} into an edited rendering x tgt x^{\texttt{tgt}} , which serves as a 2D pseudo-target for appearance supervision.
Existing image editing models [ 37 ] can leverage their learned priors to make rendered views more realistic, but often alter the camera perspective or object pose, as analyzed in Sec. 4.2 .
We propose Reinforced Editing to enable structure-preserving enhancement on top of pre-trained editing models.
Different from the original FlowEdit [ 15 ] that transfers between separate conditions c src c^{\texttt{src}} and c tgt c^{\texttt{tgt}} in Eq. 5 , our goal is to enhance the rendered view to better resemble a novel view of x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} , where no independent c src c^{\texttt{src}} exists.
We thus guide the target branch toward c ref = c tgt c^{\texttt{ref}}=c^{\texttt{tgt}} and replace the source branch with an unconditional prediction: v ~ = v ϕ w ​ ( x t tgt , t , c ref ) − v ϕ ​ ( x t src , t , ∅ ) , \tilde{v}=v_{\phi}^{w}(x_{t}^{\texttt{tgt}};t,c^{\texttt{ref}})-v_{\phi}(x_{t}^{\texttt{src}};t,\emptyset), (7) where v ϕ v_{\phi} is the velocity field of the pre-trained 2D editor, w w is the classifier-free guidance scale [ 12 ] , and c ref c^{\texttt{ref}} encodes both the reference image x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} and a text prompt indicating a viewpoint change, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Datasets. Existing 3D benchmarks such as Objaverse [ 6 ] subsets focus on everyday objects, where pre-trained baselines already do well and fidelity gaps stay hidden.
To cover the more complex needs of image-to-3D users, especially imaginative and diverse concept-design tasks, we curate a Conceptual Design Dataset of 2,396 in-the-wild reference images under-served by existing 3D priors.
We hold out 100 references for evaluation and use the remaining 2,296 for training. OREO uses these images alone and requires no paired 3D ground truth.
Curation and filtering details are in Supp. Material .
For a general-distribution reference, we additionally evaluate on Google Scanned Objects (GSO) [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集. 现有的3D基准,如Objaverse[6]子集侧重于日常物体,经过事先训练的基线已经很好,忠诚差距仍然隐藏。
为了满足图像到-3D用户更为复杂的需要,特别是富有想象力和多样的概念设计任务,我们整理了一个概念设计数据集,由2,396个内置参考图像组成,现有3D前身服务不足.
我们提出100项评价参考,并将其余2 296项用于培训。 OREO单独使用这些图像,不需要配对的3D地面真伪.
校正和过滤细节载于Supp. Material。
作为一般分发参考,我们额外评价了Google扫描对象[7]。

blocks.en: 4.2 Validating the Editing Feedback
blocks.zh: 4.2 验证编辑反馈

blocks.en:
The 3D generator is supervised by edited-rendering pseudo-targets from a 2D editor, so the quality of these edits directly bounds what the 3D loop can achieve.
We therefore first evaluate the editor’s feedback at the 2D level.
blocks.zh:
3D生成器由一个2D编辑器的编辑式发送伪目标监督,因此这些编辑的质量直接约束了3D循环能够实现的目标.
因此,我们首先在2D级评价编辑的反馈。

blocks.en:
Evaluation Protocol. For each of the 100 held-out references in the Conceptual Design Dataset, we generate a 3D asset with Trellis and render 5 views at azimuths − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} , − 45 ∘ -45^{\circ} , 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} as source views x src x^{\texttt{src}} .
To evaluate the editing performance, we adopt three metrics.
To measure the multi-view fidelity improvement, we compute the CLIP-ViT-L/14 [ 30 ] and DINOv3-ViT-L/16 [ 33 ] embedding similarity of each rendered view to the reference x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} , and report the mean over the 5 views before and after editing. To check content preservation, we additionally report the similarity to x src x^{\texttt{src}} .
Additionally, to quantify viewpoint and silhouette preservation, we compute Mask IoU between the edited output and x src x^{\texttt{src}} , using foreground masks extracted by U 2 -Net [ 29 ] as in Trellis.

Qualitative Analysis. Fig. 3 compares the feedback sources along two requirements: improving appearance while preserving the viewpoint and content of x src x^{\texttt{src}} .
NanoBanana Pro often follows the reference image too aggressively, replacing the source viewpoint with a frontal view and altering local content such as the mage’s cape.
Qwen-Image-Edit introduces larger structural changes, including pose deformation, cropping, and background drift.
In contrast, Reinforced Editing retains the source perspective and layout while adding appearance details, producing edited renderings that are better aligned with the rendered views.

Quantitative Results. Table 1 tests whether each editor provides the desired appearance-improvement direction. Similarity to x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} measures semantic and appearance alignment, while similarity to x src x^{\texttt{src}} and Mask IoU assess whether the source-view structural conditions remain stable. The unedited row provides the baseline, and the positive Δ \Delta CLIP/ Δ \Delta DINO values shown for RE simply confirm that editing improves its alignment with x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} .

RE provides a cleaner fidelity-improvement signal: it moves the rendered view toward the reference in appearance while avoiding unwanted changes in viewpoint, silhouette, pose, and spatial layout. This makes its edited renderings more suitable as 2D pseudo-targets for post-training the 3D generator.

blocks.en:
Ablation Study on RE Parameters. We study two different RE parameters separately: the editing ratio N e / N N_{e}/N , which controls how much of the full reverse-time schedule is used for editing, and the absolute number of editing steps N e N_{e} , which controls how many updates are performed within that editing interval. Editing Ratio. With the schedule length fixed, a ratio of 0.25 0.25 applies editing only over a short interval and therefore produces limited detail enhancement, while a ratio of 1.0 1.0 edits the entire trajectory and causes visible changes in pose, scale, and identity.
The intermediate ratio of 0.75 0.75 improves texture fidelity while preserving the source silhouette and viewpoint, as reflected by the trends in Fig. 5 (a) and the examples in Fig. 6 (a). Editing Steps. We then vary N e N_{e} while keeping the editing ratio approximately fixed. More steps improve CLIP/DINO similarity but reduce Mask IoU and increase computation, with diminishing visual gains beyond 9 9 steps, as shown in Fig. 5 (b) and Fig. 6 (b).
We therefore use N e = 9 N_{e}=9 and N = 12 N=12 in our 3D experiments to balance improved visual fidelity, source-view structural consistency, and practical editing cost.

blocks.en:
Experimental Setup. We evaluate the 3D generation quality of Trellis distilled with OREO.
As baselines, we compare against the pre-trained Trellis and Photo3D [ 21 ] , an offline detail-enhancement method built on the same Trellis backbone.
Following the protocol in Sec. 4.2 , we render five views for each reference at azimuths − 90 ∘ -90^{\circ} , − 45 ∘ -45^{\circ} , 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} , 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} , and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} .

In addition to our proposed Conceptual Design Dataset, which targets imaginative and out-of-distribution references, we further validate on GSO [ 7 ] , an in-distribution benchmark of common real-world objects, to assess whether OREO maintains the pre-trained model’s performance on its original distribution. Quantitative and Qualitative Evaluation. Table 3 summarizes the quantitative comparison. OREO achieves clear gains in CLIP and DINO similarity on the Conceptual Design Dataset, our target imaginative distribution, while maintaining comparable performance on GSO.
Fig. 7 shows the visual comparison. Compared with the pre-trained Trellis and Photo3D, OREO recovers finer details while preserving geometry and identity across views.
Fig. 8 provides more qualitative comparisons across views. Unlike Photo3D’s detail-focused post-training, OREO updates Trellis’s sparse-structure stage to enable such shape corrections. More examples are provided in Supp. Material .
These results show that the improvements produced by Reinforced Editing can be effectively distilled into the 3D generator. Although each iteration provides only a limited update, these improvements accumulate over training and lead to substantial gains in both appearance and shape. The distilled supervision is applied to both stages of the Trellis generator, including sparse structure generation and sparse feature generation, allowing OREO to progressively improve the shape and appearance of generated assets across multiple viewpoints.

blocks.en: Full OREO combines on-policy rollouts, latent contrastive supervision, and explicit RE-edited renderings as 2D pseudo-targets. As the student evolves, this fixed supervision becomes stale and cannot correct newly visited states. Fig. 9 shows that the geometry remains largely preserved, but colors desaturate and fine-grained textures are smoothed out. Together with the lower scores in Table 4 , this supports on-policy rollouts as a way to keep supervision aligned with the evolving generator throughout training.

This variant keeps the RE-edited views but replaces latent contrastive supervision with pixel-space regression ‖ x src − x tgt ‖ 2 \|x^{\texttt{src}}-x^{\texttt{tgt}}\|^{2} , sending the loss through the decoder 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and renderer 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . Pixel MSE therefore treats all image discrepancies as direct regression errors, without distinguishing details to enhance from content to preserve. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper proposes OREO , a fidelity alignment framework for 3D generation.
Addressing the lack of visual realism in existing 3D models, we introduce an on-the-fly optimization loop that leverages 2D diffusion priors.
In the Render–Edit–Optimize loop, Reinforced Editing produces structure-preserving 2D pseudo-targets. Contrastive Distillation uses edited and source renderings as conditions to construct positive and negative latent targets for direct generator supervision.
This design provides dynamic supervision without paired 3D ground truth, refreshing targets from the evolving generator while retaining the pretrained 3D prior for geometric stability.
Experimental results show that OREO improves the visual fidelity and texture detail of 3D generators while largely preserving structure.
Limitations are provided in Supp. Material .
blocks.zh:
本文提出了OREO,即3D生成的忠诚度比对框架.
解决现有3D模型缺乏视觉现实主义的问题,我们引入了利用2D传播前科的飞行优化循环.
在Render-Edit-Optimize循环中,强化编辑产生结构保留2D伪目标. 相矛盾的消化利用编辑和源渲染作为条件,为直接发电机监督构建正负潜在目标。
这种设计提供动态监督,不配对3D地面真假,刷新进化生成器中的目标,同时保留预先训练的3D在几何稳定性之前.
实验结果表明,OREO改进了3D发电机的视觉忠诚度和纹理细节,同时在很大程度上保留了结构.

blocks.en: S2.1 Conceptual Design Dataset Construction

blocks.en:
We construct an image-only collection to support generator post-training without paired 3D supervision.
The dataset comprises 2,396 concept-design reference images that we manually curate from public online sources; most images are AI-generated or user-shared creations posted on public content platforms, reflecting the imaginative and stylized inputs that image-to-3D users bring in practice.
We prioritize references with clean foregrounds, well-defined silhouettes, and informative texture or material cues, and manually filter the collection to remove duplicates, low-resolution thumbnails, watermarked images, and content with unclear foregrounds.
We will release the dataset on our project page.

blocks.en: S2.3 Editing Setup for Compared Methods
blocks.zh: S2.3 比较方法的编辑设置

blocks.en:
Reinforced Editing and the off-the-shelf 2D editors used as baselines share the same underlying editor backbone but differ in their text-conditioning interface.
Both prompt families are fixed across the dataset without per-example tuning.
blocks.zh:
强化编辑器和作为基线使用的现成2D编辑器共用相同的基本编辑主干线,但其文本调制界面不同.
两个快速家庭都固定在数据集之间,没有每个实例的调试.

blocks.en:
Reinforced Editing. We instantiate Reinforced Editing on top of Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with N = 12 N=12 total time steps and N e = 9 N_{e}=9 editing steps applied at the last portion of the schedule (editing ratio 0.75 0.75 ).
The target branch uses classifier-free guidance with scale w = 4 w=4 , while the source branch is an unconditional forward pass, in accordance with Eq. 7 of the main paper.
The shared noise ϵ \epsilon is initialized once per view and updated at each step by injecting the CFG signal, as in Eq. 8 of the main paper.
The editing resolution matches the renderer at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 .
The text component of c ref c^{\texttt{ref}} is: “Rotate the camera. White background.”
blocks.zh:
强化编辑。 我们在Qwen-Image-Edit-2511的顶部即时进行强化编辑,其中N=12N=12总时间步骤,Ne=9N_{e}=9编辑步骤在时间表的最后一部分应用(编辑比例0.750.75).
目标分支使用标尺w=4 w=4的无分解引导,而源分支是无条件的前传,按照主纸Eq. 7.
共享噪声 QQ\epsilon 在每个视图中初始化一次,并在每个步骤上通过注入CFG信号更新,如主论文Eq. 8中.
编辑分辨率在 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 时与渲染器匹配.
c ref c^{\textt{ref}}}的文本组件是:“旋转相机。 白色背景图. “

blocks.en:
Prompt selection. We select a single fixed prompt by evaluating representative instructions on the Conceptual Design Dataset while keeping the editor and all RE hyper-parameters unchanged.
Table S1 reports the change in CLIP and DINO similarity to the reference image relative to the unedited source, together with Mask IoU to the source view.
Fidelity-only prompts provide limited gains because they do not specify that the source viewpoint should be retained, while asking the editor to generate a full 3D model substantially changes the input and produces a negative CLIP improvement.
Viewpoint instructions perform better overall; among them, “ Rotate the camera ” directly requests another view of the same object without prescribing a specific azimuth or elevation.
As shown in Table S1 , adding “ White background ” gives the highest Δ \Delta CLIP, a strong Δ \Delta DINO, and high Mask IoU.
It also prevents the editor from introducing scene backgrounds that are absent from the white-background source renderings.
We therefore use “ Rotate the camera. White background. ” for all experiments.
blocks.zh:
快速选择 。 我们通过评价概念设计数据集上的代表性指示,同时保持编辑器和所有RE超参数不变,来选择一个固定的提示.
表S1报告了CLIP和DINO相对于未经编辑的源的参考图像的变化,以及Mask IoU与源视图的相似性.
Fidelity-Only points提供了有限的收益,因为它们没有指定源视图应当保留,同时要求编辑器生成一个完整的3D模型对输入进行实质性的改变,并产生负面的CLIP改进.
查看点指示的总体效果较好;其中,“旋转相机”直接要求同一物体的另一视图,而不规定特定的方位角或高度。
如表S1所示,加上“白色背景 ” , 给出了最高的 \\ Delta CLIP, 强的 \ Delta DINO, 和高的 Mask IoU。
这也使得编辑器无法引入白背景源渲染中缺失的场景背景.
因此,我们使用“旋转相机。 白色背景。” 用于所有实验。

All entries share the same editor and RE hyper-parameters ( N = 12 N=12 , N e = 9 N_{e}=9 , w = 4 w=4 ); we report Δ \Delta CLIP / Δ \Delta DINO similarity to x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} relative to the unedited x src x^{\texttt{src}} , and Mask IoU with x src x^{\texttt{src}} . Bold row is our final choice.
blocks.zh: 表S1:概念设计数据集上强化编辑的快速选择。 所有条目都共享相同的编辑器和RE超参数(N = 12 N = 12 N ,N e = 9 N_{e}=9,w = 4 w=4);我们报告\Delta CLIP /\Delta DINO 与x ref x^{\textt{ref}} 相对未经编辑的 x rc x^{\texttt{src}} ,以及 Mask IoU 与x rc x^{\text{src}} 相似. 大胆的排队是我们的最后选择。

blocks.en:
Off-the-shelf editor baselines. For the feedback comparison in Sec. 4.1 of the main paper, we compare against the original Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 pipeline and NanoBanana Pro.
Because both editors expose a single visual context that concatenates the source view x src x^{\texttt{src}} and the reference x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} side by side, the prompt must first assign roles to the two images before requesting the edit: “The first image is a 3D rendered view. The second image is the reference. Edit the first image to match the reference object’s appearance. White background.” The prompt is a minimal adaptation of the effective instruction reported by Photo3D and is applied identically to both editors.
Only the editor backbone changes between runs; the released source code lists API-specific parameters, including the sampler, classifier-free guidance scale, and denoising steps.
blocks.zh:
现成编辑基线. 关于主要论文第4.1节中的反馈比较,我们比较了最初的Quen-Image-Edit-2511管道和NanoBanana Pro.
由于两个编辑都同时暴露出一个使源视图xsrc x^{\textt{src}}}和参考x ref x^{\texttt{ref}}}相邻的单一视觉上下文,所以在请求编辑前,提示必须首先指定两个图像的角色:“第一个图像是3D渲染的视图. 第二个图像是参考. 编辑第一个匹配参考对象外观的图像 。 白色背景。 提示是Photo3D报告的有效指令的最小修改,并同样适用于两个编辑.
只有编辑器主干线在运行之间改变;发布的源代码列出了API的特定参数,包括采样器,无分类器的制导尺度,以及解码步骤.

blocks.en: S3 User Preference Study Protocols
blocks.zh: S3 用户优先研究协议

blocks.en:
We conduct a user preference study to complement the automatic metrics in the main paper.
The study assesses whether generated 3D assets preserve the input image’s identity and improve visual fidelity across rendered views.
blocks.zh:
我们进行用户偏好研究,以补充主要文件中的自动衡量标准。
这项研究评估了生成的三维资产是否维护输入图像的身份,并改进各种观点的视觉忠诚度。

blocks.en:
Study setup. We use the same 100 held-out examples from the Conceptual Design Dataset as in the main evaluation.
For each example, participants are shown the input reference image and multi-view renderings generated by three methods: Pretrained (Trellis), Photo3D, and OREO.
With method names hidden, participants choose the result with the best overall quality.
blocks.zh:
学习设置. 我们使用概念设计数据集中与主要评价相同的100个搁置实例。
每个例子都显示参与者的输入参考图像和三种方法产生的多视图渲染: 预训(Trellis)、Photo3D和OREO。
随着方法名称的隐藏,参与者以最佳的整体质量选择结果.

blocks.en:
Evaluation criteria. Participants are instructed to consider three aspects jointly.
First, Fidelity measures whether the generated asset contains realistic materials, sharp boundaries, and fine-grained texture details.
Second, Consistency measures whether the rendered views remain coherent as a 3D object rather than showing view-dependent artifacts.
Third, Identity measures whether the asset preserves the input image’s semantic identity and distinctive details.
blocks.zh:
评价标准。 指示与会者共同考虑三个方面。
第一,Fidelity衡量所生成的资产是否包含现实的材料,尖锐的界限,以及精细的纹理细节.
第二,一致性衡量所提供的观点是否作为一个立体物体保持连贯性,而不是显示依赖视图的文物。
第三,身份衡量资产是否保留输入图像的语义特征和显著细节。

blocks.en:
Participants. The study includes 20 participants, including participants familiar with 3D reconstruction and computer graphics.
All participants evaluate the same 100 examples, and we aggregate their preferences over all responses.
blocks.zh:
与会者。 该研究包括20名参与者,包括熟悉3D重建和计算机图形的参与者.
所有与会者都评价同样的100个例子,我们汇总了他们对所有答复的偏好。

blocks.en: Table S2 : User preferences on 100 held-out Conceptual Design Dataset examples, assessing reference fidelity, 3D consistency, and identity preservation across views.
blocks.zh: 表S2:对100个搁置的概念设计数据集示例的用户偏好,评估参考可靠性,三维一致性,以及不同观点的身份保护.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table S2 , OREO receives the highest aggregate preference share, with 38% of all responses.
With only aggregate preference ratios recorded, we report descriptive results without unsupported significance tests.
blocks.zh:
如表S2所示,OREO获得最高的总优先份额,占所有答复的38%。
由于只记录了总的偏好比率,我们报告描述性结果时没有不支持的重大测试。

blocks.en: S4 Computational Overhead
blocks.zh: S4 计算 间接费用

blocks.en:
Each OREO training iteration consists of two costs: a generator update (rollout, render, and backward pass), and a call to the frozen 2D editor to produce the edited rendering x tgt x^{\texttt{tgt}} .
The generator update alone takes roughly 22 s per iteration.
If the 9-step editing call is executed sequentially inside the same iteration, it dominates the wall-clock cost, contributing about 81% of the total per-iteration time and stretching one iteration to roughly 5 × \times the generator-only cost.
blocks.zh:
每个OREO训练迭代包含两个成本:一个生成器更新(推出,渲染,和后传),以及呼叫被冷冻的2D编辑器生成编辑的渲染 x tgt x^{\texttt{tgt}} .
仅发电机更新就需每集22秒左右。
如果9步的编辑调用在同一个迭代中按顺序执行,则它支配着墙钟成本,贡献了总的每进一次时间的约81%,并且将一个迭代伸展到大约5×xxxx时间的只发生器成本.

blocks.en: S5 Limitations and Failure Cases
blocks.zh: S5 限制和失败案件

blocks.en:
OREO inherits its appearance guidance from the 2D editing prior, and thus may also inherit the editor’s compositional or viewpoint biases in rare cases.
We discuss three representative failure modes on the Conceptual Design Dataset and a limitation for generators that decouple geometry and appearance.
blocks.zh:
OREO继承了前2D编辑的外观指导,因此在罕见的情况下也可能继承编辑的构成或观点偏差.
我们讨论了概念设计数据集的三个代表性故障模式,以及将几何和外观脱钩的发电机的限制。

blocks.en:
Viewpoint drift on face-like objects. For face-like objects or characters, the 2D editor may rotate the face toward the camera instead of preserving the intended 3D-facing direction, leading to view-dependent orientation inconsistency.
This drift arises from a mismatch between the 2D editor’s canonical portrait prior and the 3D view-consistency requirement, so edited renderings may reorient a face toward the camera; repeated use of such targets can improve local facial details while causing inconsistent face orientation across views.
blocks.zh:
视点漂移在像面的物体上。 对于面部类似对象或字符,2D编辑器可能将面部旋转到相机上,而不是保留预定的3D向上方向,导致视线依赖方向不一致.
这种偏差源于2D编辑器的犬形肖像之前和3D视图一致性要求之间的不匹配,因此经过编辑的渲染可能会将一张脸转向镜头;重复使用这样的目标可以改善局部面部细节,同时造成不同观点的面部取向不一致.

blocks.en:
Editor-inherited color and style bias. The dynamic noise update tightens alignment with the editor’s appearance prior and can therefore inherit editor-specific color bias on unusual materials such as stone or metallic surfaces, shifting the intended hue while preserving geometry.
Stylized materials outside the editor’s photographic training distribution may also undergo style shifts.
blocks.zh:
编辑器继承的颜色和风格偏差. 动态噪声更新会与编辑器之前的外观收紧,因此可以继承编辑器在石头或金属表面等不寻常材料上的特异性色彩偏差,在保留几何特征的同时转移预定的色调.
编辑摄影培训外的固定材料也可能进行风格转变。

blocks.en:
Remaining artifacts on weakly constrained regions. Rarely observed regions such as occluded surfaces, thin appendages, and sharp material boundaries receive weaker per-view supervision and can retain small local artifacts on back views and along thin structures.
These regions are also under-constrained by the reference x ref x^{\texttt{ref}} , which only depicts a single canonical viewpoint.
blocks.zh:
残存的文物在薄弱的受限地区。 极少数观测到的区域,如占地表,薄附着物,以及尖锐的物质边界,都得到较弱的每景监督,可以在背面和薄结构上保留少量的局部文物.
这些区域也受到参考x ref x^{\textt{ref}}}的限制不足,

blocks.en:
Requirements on the generator architecture. OREO requires the optimized stage to provide a conditional flow-based latent model and a frozen pretrained counterpart for constructing the positive and negative predictions.
In Trellis, this requirement is satisfied by both stages: Stage 1 represents the sparse structure with a latent on a dense 3D grid, whereas Stage 2 generates sparse SLAT features at the active coordinates.
The contrastive formulation can therefore be applied to Stage 1, Stage 2, or both.
For generators that decouple geometry and appearance, however, the improvements brought by OREO may be less consistent, as the editing signal cannot jointly constrain both components.
blocks.zh:
对发电机结构的要求。 OREO要求优化阶段,以提供有条件的基于流量的潜在模型和用于构建正负预测的冷冻预加固对应物.
在Trellis案中,这两个阶段都满足了这一要求: 第1阶段代表着在密集的3D网格上潜伏的稀疏结构,而第2阶段则在活动坐标上产生稀疏的SLAT特征.
因此,对比性表述可以适用于第一阶段、第二阶段或两者兼有。
然而,对于脱落几何和外观的发电机,OREO带来的改进可能不太一致,因为编辑信号不能共同约束两个组件.

blocks.en: These observations suggest future directions such as stronger multi-view consistency constraints, 3D-aware editing models, or uncertainty-aware filtering of edited renderings before they are used as 2D pseudo-targets for generator updates.
blocks.zh: 这些观察提出了未来的方向,如更强的多视图一致性限制,3D-意识编辑模型,或者在编辑的渲染被作为2D伪目标用于生成器更新之前对编辑的渲染进行不确定性-意识过滤.
